account:
So far today, town business has appeared routine. I attended morning correspondence, walked the market asking for news, went home for lunch, and have now returned to town hall for the accounts appointment, a little late at 13:21. The secretary has reported no correspondence, matter requiring my decision, or substantiated unusual business. Residents I asked had no news either.

The one possible lead is that the builder was looking for the innkeeper and the freight operator. I overheard the neighbour saying they had not seen either, then asked for clarification. The neighbour said the builder had business with them but had not explained it, and knew of nothing amiss. Later the neighbour spotted the innkeeper near the town hall entrance. I went into the great hall to look, but did not find them; my greeting received no answer because nobody was close enough to hear. I also noticed a lantern appear at (-58, -60, 32) in the great hall at 10:36, but did not see who placed it or why.

These details might simply reflect ordinary building, lodging, or freight arrangements. I have no evidence of a secret gathering or a particular hidden purpose, and cannot yet connect the lantern with the builder's inquiries. My feeling that something may be happening without me remains only a suspicion. I will keep my appointments, including tea at the neighbour's dockside cottage at three, and seek clearer information through ordinary conversation.
